text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Aside from the possibility of Ovarian Hyperstimulation Syndrome [see Warnings and Precautions (5.2 , 5.3) ] and multiple gestations [see Warnings and Precautions (5.5) ] , there is no additional information concerning the consequences of acute overdosage with Follistim AQ Cartridge.
